title: The HydroGym reinforcement learning platform for fluid dynamics.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Queried the Hugging Face API for dynamicslab/HydroGym-environments: public, not gated, last modified 2026-04-10. File tree is one folder per flow environment (e.g. Cavity_2D_Re4140, Cylinder_3D_Re3900, DRA2303Jet_3D_Re400000_Ma02) holding simulation restart states (.Netcdf), grids, geometry/config files (.toml/.yaml), STL edges and a baseline_state.feather. No labelled table seen. Did not download any file.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: 60+ flow-control environments, Reynolds numbers up to 4e5, flow fields up to 75 GB and test trajectories up to 15 TB (full data only on request), 38% skin-friction reduction from zero-shot transfer. Code on Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.21062222.

a1_downloadable.note: Checked via API: Hugging Face dataset is public and ungated. The largest DNS (direct numerical simulation) datasets are only available on request, according to the paper.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Checked the file tree: these are reinforcement-learning simulation environments (initial states, grids, configs), not a feature/label table. A supervised label would have to be generated by running simulations. The topic is also fluid dynamics, not biology, so it is outside this project's scope.

a3_inputs_present.note: Inputs are simulator states that must be stepped by a CFD (computational fluid dynamics) solver. No fixed input matrix exists.

a4_units_stated.note: Not checked. Simulation quantities are nondimensional (Reynolds/Mach), and there is no tabular label to which units would apply.

a5_enough_rows.note: No labelled rows. Data is generated on demand by simulation.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; paper cites flow fields up to 75 GB
a6_fits_laptop.note: From the paper only: 3D turbulent environments need HPC (high-performance computing) solvers. The small 2D cases might run on a laptop, but that was not verified.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: Not applicable: there are no row counts to compare.

a8_label_provenance.note: Any reward or target comes from simulation output, not from a physical biological measurement.

honest_claim_h3: Not applicable: this is a fluid-dynamics reinforcement-learning benchmark, not a biology dataset with measured labels.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use simulated airflow states to learn control actions that reduce drag, which is outside biology.
plain_idea.train_on: Interactive fluid-flow simulations (60+ environments, according to the paper). There is no fixed count of labelled examples.
plain_idea.predict: Actuator commands (jets, surface motion) that maximise a reward computed by the flow simulator, not a lab measurement.
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Useful to fluid-dynamics and reinforcement-learning researchers, but irrelevant to a biology-focused project search.

ml_idea: None in scope. This is a reinforcement-learning benchmark for fluid-flow control with no biological labels.

effort.compute_note: Not estimated: rejected at Part A.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Is the topic biology? No. That is enough to stop.

verdict_reason: Off-topic (fluid dynamics, not biology). The data is a set of reinforcement-learning simulation environments with no supervised label column (fails A2); checked the Hugging Face file tree.
